project_type: TypeScript monorepo - cozy pixel-art MMO life sim (Phaser 3 + Next.js 14 + Supabase)
build_system: pnpm workspaces + Turborepo. Packages: game-engine, shared, database, ui, web.
test_framework: Vitest (unit) in each package __tests__/ dir, Playwright (E2E). Tests colocated as packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/*.test.ts and apps/web/src/__tests__/*.test.ts.
verification_instructions: 1) pnpm format:check  2) pnpm lint  3) pnpm build  4) pnpm test
environment_constraints: No Docker daemon available. No hosted Supabase credentials. All features must be locally testable without network. Files must stay under 300 lines. 12 locales required for all user-visible strings. ECS pattern: pure ops functions + thin system class. Age 10-18: no violence/gambling/mature content.
contribution_requirements: Conventional commits with scope. Prettier 88 chars. ESLint max-warnings=0. One class/component per file, split at ~300 lines. Components are pure data, systems contain logic, ops functions are pure. i18n keys (decision D8) - never literal strings in engine. ITEM_NAME_KEYS in apps/web/src/i18n/index.ts must cover all items. All 12 locale files must have identical keys.
key_patterns: Feature module pattern: packages/game-engine/src/<feature>/ with index.ts, <feature>Definitions.ts (data/constants), <feature>Ops.ts (pure logic), <feature>State.ts (types). Component: packages/game-engine/src/components/<Feature>Component.ts extending Component with string type. System: packages/game-engine/src/systems/<Feature>System.ts extending System. Exports from packages/game-engine/src/index.ts. New items: add to packages/shared/src/items.ts ItemId union + ITEM_DEFINITIONS + i18n ITEM_NAME_KEYS + all 12 locale message files. Achievements: add condition kind + definition. Dialogue: dialogueDefinitions.ts with i18n textKey/labelKey. NpcCatalogue.ts for NPC placement.
directory_structure: packages/game-engine/src/ has: ecs/ (core), components/, systems/, and feature dirs (fishing/, animals/, quiz/, cooking/, crafting/, housing/, accessibility/, achievements/, collection/, festivals/, dialogue/, quests/, interaction/, inventory/, animation/, shop/, world/). packages/shared/src/ has items.ts, constants.ts, economy.ts, utils.ts. apps/web/src/ has i18n/messages/ (12 .ts files), game/, stores/, components/, __tests__/.
